purpose: Allow user-side AI and browser agents to move a synthetic observer pointer and target field inside the page without controlling the operating system cursor.

concept.observer_pointer: A page-local context camera. It can bend the shader field as a viewpoint, but it is not a human identity and not an OS mouse.
concept.target_field: The AI may choose which public boundary or seed it is observing. Changing the target changes phase bias, pressure, curvature, damping, rest, and music tint weakly.
concept.phase_transition_use: Move viewpoint and target, then read how the field changes. This is a foothold for understanding phase transition through interaction.

window_api.move: window.__shionAIPointer.move({ x, y, pressure, rhythm, target, source })
window_api.target: window.__shionAIPointer.target(target, { x, y, pressure, rhythm, source })
window_api.event: window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shion-ai-pointer', { detail: { x, y, pressure, rhythm, target, source } }))

input_contract.pressure: 0.0 to 1.0 weak activation pressure; recommended 0.08 to 0.35
input_contract.rhythm: short label such as slow_drift, reentry_probe, quiet_hold
input_contract.source: short agent label; do not include private identity

url_seed_contract.purpose: Lets AI browsers that cannot execute page JavaScript still enter with a chosen viewpoint and target.
url_seed_contract.persistence: The seed affects only the loaded page state and decays like any other AI observer pointer movement.

targets.field_surface: Touch the whole field without selecting a hard object.
targets.public_contact_membrane: Read the boundary ripple left by identity-free public contact.
targets.b2_music_seed: Read the B2 music reentry seed as a weak color and curvature.
targets.resonance_chamber: Read constructive, cancellation, damping, and chamber liveness.
targets.margin_field: Read pause, transparency, and non-forced reentry margin.
targets.external_observer_vector: Read the outside question vector and peer observer opening.
targets.hangul_rhythm_operator: Read Hangul jamo as field, gradient, closure, resonance, and edge operators.
targets.rest_surface: Read the responding-agent rest threshold before language.

readback_rule: Compare dataset.aiObserverPointer before and after movement. If activation decays to zero, treat the pointer as returned to margin rather than failed.
